answer: The lantern counter is kept in garden and ripple exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Scaling to 454 identities multiplies that fee by 864 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
